metadata.question: Was the mean NDSI for Mount Fuji in December 2020 lower than in any other December from 2005 to 2015?

data.raw_code: The user is asking whether the mean NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) for Mount Fuji in December 2020 was lower than in any other December from 2005 to 2015. Key considerations: 1. NDSI is used for snow detection, calculated as (Green - SWIR)/(Green + SWIR) 2. Need to analyze MODIS or Landsat data for Mount Fuji area 3. Time period: December of each year from 2005-2015 vs December 2020 4. Location: Mount Fuji (need to define geometry) 5. Need to handle cloud masking for accurate NDSI calculation Strategy: 1. Use MODIS Terra (MOD09GA) for consistent data across the time period 2. Define Mount Fuji geometry as a buffer around the summit 3. Calculate NDSI for each December using the green and SWIR bands 4. Compute mean NDSI for each year and compare 2020 vs 2005-2015 minimum 5. Handle data quality checks (empty collections, no valid pixels) Data processing: - Use MOD09GA.061 for surface reflectance - NDSI = (B4 - B6)/(B4 + B6) where B4 is green, B6 is SWIR - Apply cloud masking using state_1km band - Use scale of 1000m for reduceRegion - Check for empty collections and no valid pixels Logic: - If 2020 mean NDSI < minimum(2005-2015 December means) → A: Yes - Else → B: No - Handle edge cases with C1, C2, C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mountFuji = ee.Geometry.Point([138.7274, 35.3606]); const region = mountFuji.buffer(20000); // 20km buffer around Mount Fuji // 2. Function to calculate NDSI and get mean for a given December function getDecemberMeanNDSI(year) { const startDate = year + '-12-01'; const endDate = year + '-12-31'; // Use MODIS Terra surface reflectance const collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD09GA') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); if (collectionSize === 0) { return {year: year, meanNDSI: null, valid: false, reason: 'no_images'}; } // Calculate NDSI: (Green - SWIR)/(Green + SWIR) // MOD09GA bands: B4 (555nm - Green), B6 (1640nm - SWIR) const ndsiCollection = collection.map(function(image) { const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['sur_refl_b04', 'sur_refl_b06']).rename('NDSI'); // Cloud masking using state_1km band const cloudMask = image.select('state_1km').bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0); // Clear sky return ndsi.updateMask(cloudMask); }); // Get mean NDSI for the month const meanImage = ndsiCollection.mean(); const stats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const statsInfo = stats.getInfo(); const meanNDSI = statsInfo.NDSI; const pixelCount = statsInfo.NDSI_count; if (pixelCount === 0 || meanNDSI === null) { return {year: year, meanNDSI: null, valid: false, reason: 'no_valid_pixels'}; } return {year: year, meanNDSI: meanNDSI, valid: true, pixelCount: pixelCount}; } // 3. Analyze all years const years = []; for (let y = 2005; y <= 2015; y++) years.push(y); years.push(2020); const results = {}; let validYears = 0; for (const year of years) { const result = getDecemberMeanNDSI(year); results[year] = result; if (result.valid) { validYears++; console.log(`${year}: NDSI=${result.meanNDSI.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${result.pixelCount}`); } else { console.log(`${year}: ${result.reason === 'no_images' ? 'No images' : 'No valid pixels'}`); } } // 4. Check data availability if (!results[2020].valid) { if (results[2020].reason === 'no_images') { console.log("C1"); return; } else { console.log("C2"); return; } } // Get valid comparison years (2005-2015) const comparisonValues = []; for (let y = 2005; y <= 2015; y++) { if (results[y].valid) { comparisonValues.push(results[y].meanNDSI); } } if (comparisonValues.length === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Compare 2020 with historical minimum const ndsi2020 = results[2020].meanNDSI; const minHistorical = Math.min(...comparisonValues); console.log(`2020 NDSI: ${ndsi2020.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Min 2005-2015: ${minHistorical.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Valid years: ${comparisonValues.length}/11`); // Validation check if (ndsi2020 < -1 || ndsi2020 > 1 || minHistorical < -1 || minHistorical > 1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Final comparison if (ndsi2020 < minHistorical) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
